_about: Every time budget the benches and the soak hold (issue #232). Each figure has a name, a budget, the statistic it holds, and whether a miss blocks a merge or only reports. `budget` is milliseconds for the ms figures, a share for `ratio`, and a count of steps for `count over`, where `overMs` is the time a step must pass to count. Headroom is budget over measured; a figure under `warnBelowHeadroom` gets a warning on CI. The budgets are absolute and are not scaled by any calibration run (PRD, Testing). They are not game balance, so the balance stamp leaves this file out. No prices here, so no source years.

routing.route.name: one route across the 30,000 segment grid

blocks.update-share.name: a BuildRoad's block update, as a share of rebuilding every block

grid.step.name: the step that applies a BuildRoadGrid at the cap, inside the tick

levels.step.name: planning and building a road across 52 streets, inside the tick

scale.road-command-and-take-back.name: a road command's step and taking it back, twice the tick since the take-back costs about as much again

scale.step.name: a step on the scale city, inside the tick

scale.autosave-part.name: one part of an autosave on the scale city, between two ticks

town.step.name: a step on the scale town, inside the tick

cities.step.name: a step on each scale city of M3-20, the mean over two game days, inside the tick

town.autosave-part.name: one part of an autosave on the scale town, between two ticks

town.query.name: a cell or lot query the client makes per chunk or pointer move, inside a 60 fps frame

grower.tick.name: a grower tick on the scale city, the median of 30, inside the tick

grower.share.name: a grower tick with every demand bar at 100, or at growthPerDayMax, its quarter of the tick

landvalue.tick.name: the land value system's worst tick on the scale town, working out the city centre on a month's first tick, its tenth of the tick

landvalue.query.name: one cell's land value, read per pointer move or per cell the grower weighs; a few microseconds, so a budget that catches a slower lookup

demand.tick.name: the demand system's worst tick on the scale town, a day's first: from the issue's 0.1 ms while it read only running totals, a tenth of the tick since #420 made it count the homes still filling, one pass over the 54,000 buildings, and read the open jobs, about 0.25 ms on the development container

arrivals.tick.name: the arrivals system's worst tick on the scale town: every home empty, so its pass over the buildings finds them all and weighs each by its land value, and since M3-21 the people due follow that empty room, about 300 households moving in on the tick; a fifth of the tick, raised from three twentieths when M3-21 made the people due follow the empty room, and from a tenth when M3-25 weighted the draw

displaced.bulldoze-step.name: the step that applies a BulldozeBuilding at its cap of occupied homes on the scale town, its pops displaced and the first slice placed, inside the tick

displaced.drain-tick.name: a step on the scale town that places a slice of displaced pops from the queue, inside the tick

jobs.tick.name: the job matching system's worst tick on the scale town: 150,000 pops looking and every job open, the day's first slice of 1,500; half the tick, for a case a city meets only when every pop looks at once

satisfaction.tick.name: the satisfaction system's ticks on the scale town in an exodus: 150,000 pops, every pop in the day's slice of 1,500 moving out at once; a fifth of the tick, for a case a city meets only when every pop leaves together

turnover.tick.name: the turnover system's ticks on the scale town on a day every pop is replaced: 150,000 pops, every pop in the day's slice of 1,500 moving out and a newcomer drawn for its home; a fifth of the tick, for a case no city meets

vacancy.tick.name: the vacancy check's ticks on the scale town on a day every building changes: 54,000 buildings, every one in the day's slice of 542 abandoned at once, or come back at once, the worse of the two; a fifth of the tick, for a case a city meets only when a whole town empties or returns together

vacancy.waiting.name: the grower's count of the abandoned buildings that may come back, on the scale town with every building abandoned: one pass over 54,000 buildings' flags, once on a tick the grower adds a building; a twentieth of the tick

upkeep.tick.name: the upkeep system on a day's first tick on the scale city of 500,000 residents, the tick it charges the day's road upkeep from the running sum; a twentieth of the tick

tax.tick.name: the tax sweep's ticks on the scale city of 500,000 residents, each tick visiting a hundredth of its buildings and charging each occupied home its day of property tax; a twentieth of the tick

demand.outside.name: working out which of the scale town's 30,000 segments reach outside again, in the step after a change of roads

soak.command-steps.name: steps of one command type over the tick in the soak hour, two runner pauses allowed

soak.settle-steps.name: zoning cell settle steps over the tick in the soak hour, two runner pauses allowed

soak.idle-steps.name: idle steps over the tick in the soak hour, two runner pauses allowed

soak.autosave-parts.name: autosaves whose slowest part passed the tick in the soak hour, three collections allowed

client.cell-layer.later-chunk.name: the zoning overlay's slowest chunk after the first, under the first chunk's 20 ms

client.grid-tool.preview.name: the grid tool's preview of a grid at the cap, inside a 60 fps frame

travel.query.name: one travel time between two zones, read from the table
